text:
devon: quick heads-up — while reviewing the per-route usage dashboard docs I noticed the header name in the SDK example doesn't match the ingestion pipeline. docs shows "X-Usage-Tier" but the metrics indexer expects "X-Redwood-Usage-Tier". that will misattribute tokens in the panel.

maria: thanks for flagging. do you have a minimal snippet we can swap into the PR?

devon: here's a tiny repro I used locally:
```js
// node/fetch example
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer <token>`,
    'X-Redwood-Usage-Tier': 'team-pro',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4-small', prompt: 'hi' })
});
```
That maps to the "route_tier" label in Grafana.

samir: fyi — backend currently accepts both header names case-insensitively but we only index "x-redwood-usage-tier" into the "route_tier" tag. we can either update docs or add a long-term shim; i recommend changing docs + a short migration note.

elaine: product note — if we update docs, add a migration example for older SDKs that emit "X-Usage-Tier" and clarify that dashboards should filter on "route_tier" vs "account_tier". also pls fix the grafana link on the page (404).

maria: plan for the PR:
- replace header examples across the billing + dashboard pages
- add migration bullet explaining fallback mapping
- include python + JS SDK snippets (python is high volume)
- update grafana link and add a screenshot showing the "route_tier" filter

devon: small nit — add a one-line explanation about when tier attribution happens (ingestion time vs post-agg). customers trip up on that.

maria: noted. @samir can you confirm the exact wording for the fallback so i don't misrepresent behavior?

samir: confirmed: ingestion normalizes headers to lowercase and maps header "x-redwood-usage-tier" into the "route_tier" index. if only "x-usage-tier" is present we map it for compatibility but it's deprecated and not guaranteed indefinitely. i'll add that sentence to the PR.

docs-bot: PR #4928 updated by maria — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4928 (diff: +12 -7)

elaine: once CI is green i'll merge. can someone also add a quick regression test to catch the broken grafana link? that was the root cause here.

devon: i can add a small integration test that requests the built docs page and verifies the grafana URL returns 200 (or points to the new panel). will follow up with a separate PR.

maria: thanks all — i'll push the edits today and tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
